hero.title: Once a Navodayan, always family.
hero.subtitle: Reconnect with your batch, back the students who walk the same corridors today, and be there for the next reunion.

vision: To strengthen the bond between our alumni and the school, and to stand behind every student who follows us.

join.title: Your batch is already here.
join.body: Sign up with your passing year to find batchmates, hear about reunions first and post jobs to the network.

giving.title: The school gave us a start. Pay it forward.
giving.body: Alumni fund scholarships, mentoring and campus projects. Every rupee is recorded in the association's public accounts.

areas.title: Scholarships
areas.body: Fees and coaching for students from the school who need a hand to reach college.

areas.title: Mentoring
areas.body: Alumni guide students through careers, exams and their first jobs.

areas.title: Campus & community
areas.body: Plantation drives, sports fests and projects that bring batches back to campus.
